demos.ticket_text: The password reset email link redirects me to a broken 404 page whenever I click it on Chrome.
We received a legal compliance notice regarding counterfeit listings using our trademark on your marketplace and need immediate executive contact.
What are your usual shipping fees and delivery timeframes for rural areas?
Can you confirm which card will receive the refund once my returned headphones from order ORD-2012 arrive?
I forgot to apply my 20% discount promo code during checkout for order ORD-3006. Can you adjust the billing total?

signature.instructions: Classify a customer support message into the exact department category, extract any explicit order ID, and assign its urgency priority.

fields.description: The customer support ticket message describing a question, request, or issue.
A short plan for solving the task.

Choose strictly one department based on the core topic: 'Shipping' (package delivery, courier, tracking status, customs, shipping address/fees), 'Refund' (returning an item, money back, reimbursement, order cancellation for refund), 'Payment' (credit/debit card charges, billing, declined payment, invoice, promo code, payment methods), 'Technical' (website/app bugs, login/2FA errors, server 500/404 errors, software license/firmware/UI issues), or 'Other' (account ownership/merging, GDPR/legal, wholesale partnership, staff complaint, general hours/feedback).
Extract the exact order ID matching 'ORD-XXXX' ONLY if explicitly written in ticket_text; otherwise return null.

Choose strictly one urgency level: 'High' (urgent deadline, outage/locked out, double/unauthorized charge, lost/damaged delivery, security/safety/legal), 'Medium' (standard issue needing action: declined card, return label, delayed tracking, address typo, bug workaround), or 'Low' (general policy question, opening hours, feedback/thank you, non-urgent inquiry).
